raw_segments.text: Were I inclined to continue this parallel, I could easily prove that almost all the differences
which may be remarked between the characters of the Americans in the Southern and in the
Northern States have originated in slavery.
But this would divert me from my subject, and my present intention is not to point out
all the consequences of servitude, but those effects which it has produced upon the prosperity
of the countries which have admitted it.
